title: AI Discovery in Combinatorics: From Problems to Solutions and Back to Bigger Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.16555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce $qt$Bench, a benchmark of 29 open problems in algebraic combinatorics. These problems ask for a simple combinatorial algorithm that explains given polynomial coefficients or identities. To help AI agents search for such algorithms, we provide a scaffold for playing with combinatorial objects, countering cheating attempts, and testing candidate solutions. To explore how far frontier AI systems can go on these problems, we collaborated with OpenAI, whose researchers obtained proposed solutions to several of them. This highlights bigger meta-problems: is AI discovery at scale ethical? How should these results be released? How should proof digestion be organized? We discuss these questions and give our views.

translated_title: 组合数学中的AI发现：从问题到解决方案，再回到更大的问题
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了$qt$Bench，这是一个包含29个代数组合数学开放问题的基准测试。这些问题要求找到能够解释给定多项式系数或恒等式的简单组合算法。为了帮助AI智能体搜索此类算法，我们提供了一个脚手架，可用于操作组合对象、防范作弊尝试以及测试候选解决方案。为了探索前沿AI系统在这些问题上能走多远，我们与OpenAI展开了合作，其研究人员获得了其中若干问题的拟议解决方案。这凸显了更重大的元问题：大规模的AI发现是否符合伦理？这些结果应该如何发布？证明的消化整理应该如何组织？我们讨论了这些问题并给出了我们的观点。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含29个代数组合数学开放问题的基准$qt$Bench，并提供脚手架辅助AI智能体搜索组合算法，与OpenAI合作获得了若干问题的拟议解决方案，同时探讨了大规模AI发现引发的伦理、成果发布与证明消化等元问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces $qt$Bench, a benchmark of 29 open problems in algebraic combinatorics with a scaffold to help AI agents search for combinatorial algorithms, collaborates with OpenAI to obtain proposed solutions to several problems, and raises meta-questions about the ethics, release, and proof digestion of AI discovery at scale.
